title: Design
coreMove: Arrange choices so they reinforce one another as a designed whole.
sourcePressure: Strategy becomes design when choices fit and reinforce one another around structural limits rather than existing as isolated improvements. Frozen source has no chapter-specific named figure, study, place, or event beyond the visible title/support notes; use conceptual source terms only and do not invent anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Design means making the plan elegant, creative, or visually polished.

any hook that starts with Strategy is...
counterintuition: Most people think X, but actually Y
